deploy-bot: HOTFIX DEPLOY STARTED: tagged release v1.6.9-hotfix -> prod-eu-west

deploy-bot: commit: 7a3f2b9 (short) | rolling canary policy: 5% for 10m -> 20% -> 100% | change window: 03:00-07:00 UTC

tess: starting canary now, watching error budget and p95 latency. I'll ping if anything odd. :eyes:

kevin: confirmed no schema/migration in this patch. just runtime guardrails and a retry backoff fix.

sre-oncall: thanks. I'll watch the ingress 504s and autoscaler. notify if >0.5% error spike.

miguel: tagging in release notes channel in case product wants to batch notes later.

deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE: 5% active -> metrics: 0.12% 5xx, p95 +6ms, throughput stable. proceeding to 20% in 5m. :white_check_mark:

kevin: seeing a couple of 429s in canary logs, likely burst throttling. increasing client-side retry window helps.

tess: can you paste the snippet? I can patch if needed.

kevin: snippet:
```
// client backoff tweak
retry: {
  base: 100ms,
  max: 800ms,
  jitter: true
}
```

sre-oncall: 20% rollout starting. pushing alert thresholds on the canary to avoid noisy pagers.

deploy-bot: ROLLING -> 20% | status: healthy | rolling window extended +5m due to traffic pattern

miguel: noticed a small spike in error aggregation for a single shard (eu-west-1a). investigating whether it's infra or the code path.

tess: hold further promotion if shard spike persists. prefer to pin to 20% until we confirm.

sre-oncall: spike looks correlated with a router config hitting a conn limit. working with infra to raise soft limit for the shard.

deploy-bot: PAUSE: automated policy paused rollout at 20% due to error correlation detection. manual review required.

kevin: okay I'll revert the backoff commit in-flight and re-deploy a patch build if needed. do we want a quick rollback to v1.6.8 for affected shard users?

tess: not full rollback yet. let's 1) increase shard conn limit 2) re-run canary at 10% for 15m. if errors drop -> promote.

sre-oncall: limit bumped, routers report healthy now. initiating 10% canary watch window.

deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE: 10% -> metrics stabilized: 0.03% 5xx, p95 back to baseline. automated policy OK to continue.

tess: promoting to 50% now. I'll keep an eye for the next 10m.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE -> 50% | status: passing

miguel: leaving a note: pinned traffic routing rule for eu-west-1a for 2h to avoid future shard thrash.

kevin: thanks — will prepare a follow-up patch to harden router client backoff and include in next non-urgent PR.

deploy-bot: ROLLING -> 100% complete for prod-eu-west | tagged v1.6.9-hotfix | duration: 25m | notify: #release-notes

tess: hotfix promoted. tagging changelog and sending release note snippet.

miguel: nice work y'all. :tada: Will monitor telemetry for next 2h and raise if anything.

sre-oncall: leaving the oncall watch for 2h. clear to close thread unless new alerts.

tess: closing thread. if anyone needs rollback artifacts, run `deploy rollback v1.6.8 --env prod-eu-west` or check the deploy dashboard.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETE: v1.6.9-hotfix -> prod-eu-west (100%). Logs: https://deploys.internal/r/1995012345 | tags: hotfix, urgent, pinned-canary
